title: Quiz: Hello World
description: Check your understanding of Hello World.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in TypeScript?
questions.explanation: In TypeScript, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does a "Hello World" program mainly teach you?
options: That your code runs and produces output
How to make websites load fast
questions.correctAnswer: That your code runs and produces output
questions.explanation: It is the smallest program that proves your setup works end to end.

questions.question: True or False: A program's output always appears exactly where the print/output statement is placed in the code.
Fill in the blank: {hello}
questions.explanation: The hello-world snippet is the complete minimal program.

questions.question: In TypeScript, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
